tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// sgyu ma chen mo'i tshogs 'khor bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ sgyu ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mchog bde chen sgyu ma'i sku// mi zad gsang ba gsum bdag nyid// sgyu ma chen mor phyag 'tshal nas// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad// 'dir sngags dang sman gyis kun du byin gyis brlabs pa'i dug yongs su bsten pa ni/ zas dang sman gzhan pas bcud dang phan yon che ba ltar/ gang gis yongs su gdung bar 'gyur ba 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa de dang de dag thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis byin gyis brlabs nas yongs su spyad na/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang nyon mongs pa la mi mthun pa'i phyogs su lta ba'i lam de dag pas khyad par du 'phags pa nyid do// de nyid kyi phyir nyan thos kyi sde snod las/ 'dod pa dang 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams dug dang*/ mtshon dang*/ chom rkun dang*/ rab tu 'bar ba'i me dang 'dra bar bstan pas shin tu smad par gyur pa de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i sne snod dag las/ thabs kyis yongs su zin na lam la phan par 'gyur bar bstan te/ ji skad du rgyal ba'i yum las/ byang chub sems dpa' la la la ni pha dang ma dang chung ma dang bu dang bu mo dag kyang gdon mi za bar dgos so// zhes pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la la ni thabs mkhas pas sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la yongs su spyad de/ chung ma'i 'khor gyi nang nas mngon par byung nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes bya ba dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ 'od srungs grong khyer gyi lud gang yin pa de ni/ 'bras kyi zhing dang*/ bu ram gyi zhing dang*/ til gyi zhing la phan pa yin no// de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs pa'i lud gang yin pa de yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la phan pa yin no// zhes gsungs la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/

byis pa rnams ni gzugs la chags// bar pa rnams ni chags bral 'gyur// mkhas pa rnams kyis gzugs kyi ni// rang bzhin shes nas rnam par grol// zhes gsungs so// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las lam gyi dngos gzhir gsungs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ chags can ye shes 'dod pa yis// rtag tu 'dod yon lnga rnams bsten// zhes pa dang*/ kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud las kyang*/ skye bo mi bzad pa yi las// gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// chags pas 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba// 'dod chags nyid kyis rnam par grol// bzlog pa'i bsgom pa 'di nyid ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs cis mi shes// zhes 'byung ngo*// de'i phyir phyi dang nang gi bde ba chen po thabs khyad par du 'phags pa dang bcas pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa ni/ nges par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'phral du mngon du byed pa'i phyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i thabs kyis/ phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang*/ ye shes bsgrub pa la brtson par bya'o// de'ang las dang po pa rnams la nye bar gdams pa'i phyir de dag gi ji ltar bya ba'i tshul brjod par bya'o// de'ang dus khyad par can la bab pa'i tshe dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas byi dor legs par byas te/ bla re la sogs pas legs par brgyan nas 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gi rten nye bar bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i thod par chang dang bdud rtsi sbyar bas bkang ba'i nang gi mchod pa dang*/ shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma gsum dang*/ rdo rje dril bu dang med du mi rung ba'i rdzas kha na ma tho ba dang bral ba'i sha dang*/ chang dang*/ gzhan yang bza' ba dang*/ btung ba gya nom pa rnams legs par 'tshogs par bya'o// de nas tshogs kyi gtso bo gral gyi thog mar 'khod nas/

dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams rgan rim gyis gnas pa la/ las kyi slob mas maṇ+ḍal dang so so la me tog phul nas phyag 'tshal te/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang*// yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis bsag pa'i phyir// gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ me tog rnams bsdus te tshogs kyi gtso bo la dbul/ des kyang bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la dbul te/ cho ga la 'jug par rjes su gnang ba'i don du gsol ba btab nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis gnas khang de mi dmigs te stong par bsams pa'i ngang las/ rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du kun du bzang po'i mchod sprin dang 'dra ba'i mchod rdzas thams cad kyis yongs su gang bar bsam zhing*/ nang gi mchod pa la'ang āḥlas thod pa chen po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la/ thams cad kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas sdig pa dang sgrib pa 'dag par bya ba'i don du rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas yi ge brgya pa ci rigs pa bzlas nas/ sgyu ma chen mo'i mngon par rtogs pa gsal bar bsgoms la/ bzlas pa ci nus pa byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta'i sngags brjod cing nang mchod kyis mchod rdzas rnams bsangs nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las mchod pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge zhu ba las ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba'i mchod rdzas su bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun na dmigs pa'i rten yod pa 'am med kyang rung ste/ skad cig gis rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gsal bar dmigs nas/

dbu rgyan la rigs bdag gi rgyas btab pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bsgoms la/ rigs kyi bdag po nyid bla ma dang gnyis su med par bsams pa'i mtha' mar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar blta'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin bzung nas mchod par bsam zhing sgrub pa'i thabs nas 'byung ba'i sngags ting nge 'dzin phyag rgyas rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gtor ba'i thor ma rnams thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med par gyur pas so so la mchod par bsam zhing*/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ yi dam gyi lha gzhan dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la so so'i sngags dang mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas phul nas rang gi lce dang*/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su bdud rtsis reg pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsams nas chos skyong ba dang*/ srung ma gzhan dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dur khrod kyi bdag po dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad la so so'i sngags dang*/ mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing phul la/ mthar gzhi bdag dang 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la byin pas mnyes shing tshim par bsam mo// de nas bdag dang mchod pa'i lha mo de dag nyid kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// la sogs pas bla ma dang*/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa'i gzugs// la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bstod nas nyes ltung gi tshogs dag cing dam tshig dang sdom pa brtan par bya ba'i phyir rgyun bshags dang*/

sdom pa gzung ba yang lan gsum gyi bar du bya'o// de nas gtor ma nang gi mchod pa dang*/ chu dang*/ chang gis sbyangs la/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong ba dang*/ gsum pa yul de'i zhing skyong ba rnams la so so'i tshogs dbul bar bya'o// mdun bskyed mchod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas bdag bskyed mchod pa'i phyir tshogs kyi yo byad rnams lhan cig bsogs la nang mchod kyis gtor nas bsang ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang byin gyis brlab pa rnams gtor ma rgyas pa ltar byas te/ slar yang nang mchod nas thams cad la gtor bas yo byad thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du ro gcig par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa dang*/ ha ho hrīḥzhes yang yang brjod nas byin gyis brlab bo// des mdun bskyed dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi thugs dam bskang bar bsam zhing*/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ bdag gis bshams pa'i tshogs kyi yo byad 'di// zag pa med pa'i yon tan kun ldan zhing*// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rab 'phro ba// nam mkha' yongs su khyab par mngon sprul te// bla ma rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs rnams la// rab tu gus pa'i yid kyis bdag dbul zhing*// sdig dang ltung ba thams cad bshags pa dang*// nongs pa thams cad bzod par gsol bgyid kyis// ci bder bzhes nas bdag yid dag pa dang*// smon pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas a ho su khaṃ zhes brjod cing ma da na dang ba la'i phud mchod pa dang gtor ma la phul nas las kyi slob mas/ tshogs kyi gtso bo la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ gzhan rnams la mi 'tshal bar/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'du ba rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*// rang bzhin cig pa nyid du bzhes// zhes brjod cing dang*/

des kyang*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod cing blang*/ gnyis kas rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ a ho su khaṃ zhes brjod do// bza' btung gzhan thams cad kyang sngags de nyid kyis drang zhing blangs nas/ dam tshig gi phud nang mchod kyi skabs ltar dang*/ zas kyi phud phul nas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyad do// las kyi slob mas dam tshig ma thob kyi bar du gzhan rnams kyis dam tshig gi rdzas sa la mi bzhag cing*/ tshogs kyi gtso bos longs ma spyod par gzhan gyis longs mi spyad la/ snod kha sbub dang*/ stong par mi bzhag go /der 'dus pa'i gang zag rnams he ru ka'i ngo bo yin pas bzang ngan gyi rtog pa mi bya ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i yo byad thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir/ gtsang mi gtsang dang rung mi rung mi dbye'o// rab tu myos pa'i chang mi btung zhing chags sdang gi rnam rtog dang*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i gtam mi bya'o// rang nyid grogs dang bcas pa la de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'du shes dang*/ kha zas la ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i 'du shes dang*/ longs spyod pa la lha mchod pa'i 'du shes yang yang gsal gdab cing mchod par bya ba dang*/ mchod par byed pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yul thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o// yo byad rnams la brda'i ming gis smos par bya ste/ chang la ma da na dang*/ sha la ba la dang*/ kha zas gzhan la tri pi ta dang*/ thug pa la ma la tin dha naṃ/ snod la pad+ma bhañja na/ zhes brjod kyi phal pa'i skad kyis mi brjod do// yid spro na phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ glu dang gar gyi mchod pa yang bya ste/ skyes pas glu len na 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/

bud med kyis glu len na gos dkar mo dang*/ skyes pas gar byed pa rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ bud med kyis gar byed na sangs rgyas spyan gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa dang*/ glu ngag dag par byed pa sngags dang*/ gar lus dag par byed pa phyag rgya dang*/ stang stabs thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pas 'phags pa mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don 'byung bar bsam zhing*/ glu dang gar bya'o// bag med pas rnam par g.yengs pa'i rgod pa dang*/ gnyid dang rmugs pa la sogs pa bying bar mi bya zhing*/ cho ga ma tshar gyi bar du tshogs kyi khang pa'i phyi rol du 'gro bar mi bya'o// gal te 'gro dgos na bla ma'am grogs la zhus nas/ rnal 'byor ma nyams par song la slar ldog par bya'o// byin gyis brlabs pa'i kha zas dbang ma thob pa la mi sbyin zhing*/ gal te ster dgos na lhag ma'i gtor ma'i sngags kyis lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la bsngos nas byin na nyes par mi 'gyur ro// bza' ba dang btung bas tshim pa dang snying gar ma da na'i thig le byas la/ rang he ru ka yab yum du gsal bar dmigs nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen pos phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ snang ba thams cad kyang bde ba chen po'i rkyen drug tu 'char bar bltas nas/ bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom bar bya'o// de nas bza' btung gi lhag ma rnams bsdus pa la tshogs kyi gtso bos 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i tshogs la byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro'i sngags lan bdun brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ uts+tshi ṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes lnga'am bdun gyis bsngos la tshim par bsams nas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams mnyes shing dngos grub blang ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa thams cad byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ kol+la e re ṭaṭhi a bo lā m+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ṇe kri pi ṭa ho khādz+dzā i/ kā ru ṇe ke a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dzā i/ gā ḍeṃ ma a nā bi dz+dzā i/ ha le kā liñja ra pa ṇi a i/ dun+du ra bādz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la/ kap+pu ra lā i a ī/ mā la in+dha ṇa sā liñja ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a ī/ phreṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te shud+dha a shud+dha na ma ṇi a ī/ ni rāṃ shu aṃ ge tsā ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun+du ru bāṭ+ṭā i/ ḍiṇ+ḍ-i ma ta hin+na badz+dzi a i/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blang ngo*// de nas phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgyas par brjod pa'i mthar/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las/ phyogs dang dus kun tu rgyal bar gyur cig ces bkra shis kyi tshig gis bkra shis par bya'o// de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dngos grub slong ba'i bsam bas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa des ni lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa dang*/ bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ phyi dang nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang*/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa thob pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal he ru ka chen po'i go 'phang myur du rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// de nas cho ga lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum du bzlas nas/

ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ bzod par gsol nas las bsags pa 'bras bu mchog dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis// sangs rgyas myur du 'grub gyur te// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// bla med gnas su sgrol bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur pa// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /gnas skabs su bdag cag tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ bar chad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces bsngo ba bya'o// de nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa dngos su yod na gshegs mi dgos pas gtor ma'i mgron rkyang pa gshegs su gsol la/ rten med na mdun bskyed dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol te/ de'ang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa dang yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol nas dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// de nas grib gnon gyi gdon mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs te drag po'i sngags brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas sa'i phyogs gtsang sar dor nas rang gi dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dmigs pas bsrungs la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas pa'i phan yon ni/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang ltung ba phra mo 'dag cing bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams mnyes nas thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub gnang bar 'gyur ba dang*/

mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi thugs dang 'gal ba rnams zhi zhing dgyes par bsrung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ rang nyid kyi rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin brtan par byed cing*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du rdzogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// de nyid 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ 'dis ni rdo rje mnyes par 'gyur// ye shes me yis rab dgyes bya// rgyal ba phan pa mnyes pa dang*// gser gyi mnga' bdag mnyes pa dang*// pad+ma gar dbang mnyes pa dang*// lcags mchog bdag po mnyes pa dang*// tshangs pa brgya byin dbang chen dang*// khyab 'jug rlung dang me chen dang*// mthong ldan nyid dang 'dod lha dang*// zla ba nyi ma gdon gzhan dang*// sa ni zhags pas 'dzin pa dang*// lus ngan de bzhin mtshams skyong dang*// chos rgyal dang ni klu dang ni// dri za lha min mi'am ci// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa'i lha// 'og min du ni gnas pa dang*// gang zhig rgyal chen gnas pa dang*// gzhan 'phrul dbang sgyur nyid dang ni// 'phrul dga' yi ni lha rnams dang*// gang zhig dag pa'i gnas son dang*// 'od zer 'jig rten khams gnas dang*// mi mjed khams su gnas pa dang*// gling bzhir gnas pa'i sems can dang*// gang zhig khams gsum gnas pa dang*// snod dang sems can 'jig rten dang*// lcug ma'i tshogs dang rtswa sogs dang*// gang zhig rab dga'i sar gnas dang*// pha rol dri med gang phyin dang*// 'od 'phro can du gnas pa dang*// mi g.yo'i gnas su byas pa dang*// gang zhig chos sprin rjes song dang*// gang zhig sbyang dkar son pa dang*// gang zhig ring song thob pa dang*// 'od byed du ni gnas pa ste// sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po dang*// 'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad po dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos nyid// bse ru rā yi tshul can nyid// dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*// lha dang lha min mi rnams ni// sbyin sreg cho gas mnyes pa nyid// de nyid tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro// bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po rgya mtsho rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// zhes pa dang*/

kye'i rdo rje las/ gang du zos pas 'dod yon kun// sgrub pa po yi dngos grub 'gyur// zhes bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ rgyud kyi mthar thug pa ni gsang ba 'dus pa ste/ spyod pa'i mthar thug pa ni rdo rje thod pa yin// las kyi mthar thug pa ni gshin rje gshed po ste// bsod nams kyi mthar thug pa ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin// zhes gsungs so// skal ba dman zhing blo sngar ba'i stobs kyis 'di lta bu'i tshul la yid ches par ma gyur kyang*/ khong khro ba dang smad par bya ba ma yin te/ chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang rdzas kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs mkhas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro// de nyid bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ des na zab mo'i chos 'di la// mos pa nyid du ma gyur kyang*// smad pa nyid du mi bya ste// chos dbyings bsam mi khyab dran bya// zhes gsungs la/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yid kyi nyes pa rang bzhin gdug pa ste// mi rigs pa yi gzugs la'ang mi rig na// the tshom za ba'i chos la smos ci dgos// de phyir btang snyoms bzhag la nyes pa med// ces gsungs so// thub pa'i gsung rab zab mo'i tshul// thos shing thob pas yid ches nas// tshul bzhin nyams su len byed pa// nye ba'i ma 'ongs sangs rgyas yin// zhes shes par bya'o// de ltar sgyu ma chen mo'i rjes 'brang ba'i// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshad pa'i dge ba des// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// ye shes sgyu mas rnam par rol bar shog /dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal bu ho ko yon mchod kyi don du dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas lcags mo lug gi lo/ bya sbo zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin mo shing kun gyi sa'i char a tsa ra zhes bya bas yi ge bgyis nas sbyar ba'o//
